name: automation
description: Automated testing suite for Bayer Beyond project

scripts.test: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test
scripts.test:spec: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/SideBar.spec.ts
scripts.vrt:test: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/visual-regression.spec.ts
scripts.vrt:baseline: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/visual-regression.spec.ts --grep "Create Baseline Screenshots"
scripts.vrt:compare: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/visual-regression.spec.ts --grep "Component-Level Visual Comparison"
scripts.test:allure: npm run test && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:chromium:desktop: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/SideBar.spec.ts --project="Desktop Full HD"
scripts.test:chromium:macbook: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/SideBar.spec.ts --project="MacBook Pro"
scripts.test:chromium:tablet-land: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/SideBar.spec.ts --project="Tablet Landscape"
scripts.test:chromium:tablet-port: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/SideBar.spec.ts --project="Tablet Portrait"
scripts.test:chromium:mobile: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/SideBar.spec.ts --project="Mobile Portrait"
scripts.test:desktop: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test --project="Desktop Full HD"
scripts.test:spec:desktop: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/specs/TextWithImageComponent.spec --headed --project="Desktop Full HD"
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.test:viewport:report: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test --headed && allure generate ./reports/allure/allure-results --clean -o ./reports/allure/allure-report && allure open ./reports/allure/allure-report
scripts.test:spec:viewport:report: npx cross-env TEST_ENV=qa npx playwright test tests/specs/TextWithImageComponent.spec.ts --headed && npx allure generate ./reports/allure/allure-results --clean -o ./reports/allure/allure-report && npx allure open ./reports/allure/allure-report
scripts.git:sync: git fetch origin && git pull --rebase origin
scripts.git:update: npm run git:sync && npm run git:push
scripts.branch:clean: git fetch -p && for /f "tokens=2" %i in ('git branch -vv ^| findstr ": gone]"') do git branch -D %i
